causes.rule: On a symbol miss, classify_security reads the canonical table under the node's CUSIP key (lines 985-987) and returns that row at lines 988-995 without consulting the fallback. Line 993 reads sub_asset_class from the row with a plain get and or None; each of the 45 CUSIP-keyed rows has no sub_asset_class key at all, so the served sub-class is None, the return at line 994 carries it, and the fallback sub-class lookup at line 1003 is never reached.
causes.prior_path: Live code (the live bundle's classify_security) has no CUSIP lookup: the symbol missed the canonical table, so the node fell to the fallback, _NarrowedClassifier.get_sub_asset_class (holdings_snapshot.py lines 898-899), which reached bd_securities_fallback.py get_sub_asset_class through its name-alias branch (lines 175-180, basis NAME_ALIAS) and returned the bd-securities sub-class: Investment Grade 29, Intermediate 12, Cash 2, Municipal 1, US Small Cap 1.

options.consequence: The port keeps the sub-class where the prior path held it. Code change in words: when the CUSIP-keyed row carries no sub_asset_class, the canonical branch must not return None for the sub-class; it falls through to the fallback sub-class lookup, as the prior path did, and keeps the row's asset_class and TABLE basis. The 45 positions keep their prior labels (Investment Grade 29, Intermediate 12, Cash 2, Municipal 1, US Small Cap 1) and asset_class is unchanged on all 45.

The absence is a documented correction that Andrew is told of before the port ships. The client sees a blank sub-class on the 45 Cottonwood positions (44 fixed-income, 1 equity) where the prior release showed Investment Grade 29, Intermediate 12, Cash 2, Municipal 1 and US Small Cap 1. Asset class is unchanged on all 45; only the sub-class column goes blank for those rows.

The 45 CUSIP-keyed canonical rows gain a sub_asset_class from their classifying source, under that source's own release and outside this port. The port then serves the sub-class from the row and no fallback is needed. Nothing in the holdings code changes, but the port cannot ship until the rows are backfilled.
